text:
section
noncomputable section
open Nat
open Polynomial
open NumberField
open scoped NumberField
variable (n p : ℕ)

/-- A natural number `n` is regular if `n` is coprime with the cardinal of the class group. -/
def IsRegularNumber : Prop :=
  n.Coprime <| Fintype.card <| ClassGroup (𝓞 <| CyclotomicField n ℚ)

name: flt_regular
comment: Kummer's theorem: `p` prime (`Fact p.Prime`), regular, odd. Nothing else is assumed, and the conclusion is Mathlib's `FermatLastTheoremFor p`.
text:
section
open FltRegular

/-- Fermat's last theorem for regular primes. -/
theorem flt_regular {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hreg : IsRegularPrime p) (hodd : p ≠ 2) :
    FermatLastTheoremFor p := by
  rw [fermatLastTheoremFor_iff_int]
  apply fermatLastTheoremWith_of_fermatLastTheoremWith_coprime
  intro a b c ha hb hc hgcd
  by_cases hcase : ↑p ∣ a * b * c
  · exact caseII hreg hodd (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ha hb) hc) hgcd hcase
  · exact caseI hreg hcase
